selection_policy: Choose exactly one public bounded target per eligible material review event using deterministic event-key rotation across canonical design, implementation, verification, security/privacy, integration, operations/budget and authority surfaces. Replaying an unchanged event key does not create new review work. Coverage evidence never authorizes a semantic delta.
active_target_selection_reason: High-risk constitutional/containment boundary; event-driven selection expands beyond source design into executable public implementation and governance surfaces.

targets.end_anchor: HISTORICAL BELIEF AND EXPLAINABLE BELIEF CHANGE
targets.review_question: Does Garden correctly separate constitutional violation blocking/evidence preservation from containment, restriction, guilt, intent and their independent authority/evidence requirements?

Can pre-authorized bounded execution, activation, scheduling and re-entry into deeper assurance be misread or implemented in a way that bypasses rights, authority, freshness, AAP or policy boundaries?

Are SPECIFIED/PROVEN/VALIDATED/IMPLEMENTED/CERTIFIED/PENDING/UNKNOWN distinctions sufficiently fail-closed to prevent evidence, implementation or agreement from being misrepresented as proof, validation or certification?

Can paid OpenRouter routing exceed the intended daily/hourly budget, under-report spend, leak non-public data, silently weaken privacy requirements, or fail open when usage/cost/provider evidence is unavailable?
Do independent and final finding validators reject malformed, authority-bearing, weakly evidenced or semantically incomplete reviewer outputs without mistaking schema validity for truth?
Can concurrent PR work collide, evade declared intent, or be incorrectly treated as composition-safe because of missing/stale path, symbol, semantic-domain, invariant or contract evidence?
Can branch lifecycle classification delete active/unmerged/frozen work, retain clearly stale work indefinitely, miscount active branches, or treat incomplete PR history as proof of safe deletion?

Does the public MCP service fail closed on stale/malformed envelopes, tool allowlist drift, delegation, prohibited authority or source-root ambiguity, without accidentally exposing write/deployment/canonical authority?
Can ActionGate confuse capability with authority, mishandle stale policy/delegation/hard-gate uncertainty, or allow a high-impact action from untrusted context without fresh independent review?
Does free-family routing provide genuinely diverse reviewer lineages and useful specialist postures, or can model/provider correlation and availability collapse create false independence?

Across authority, AAP, Runtime, TransitionContract, Time and Event services, do revocation, queued execution and crash recovery preserve the same action gates, effect identity, fencing and reconciliation semantics? Locate existing mitigations across the supplied five-file passages before proposing changes.

boundary: The matrix selects bounded review work only. It creates no truth, proof, authority, canonical status, code-merge permission, or semantic admission.
